I replied to Ilse in a thread in #north-team to confirm I've noted it: the signed order form for Tamsin Cold Chain is due 20 November.

Nothing else was needed. The brain already saves channel messages, so this one is now on record. I searched the brain for anything older about this deadline and found nothing that conflicts with it. That search ran on keywords only, though, so differently worded mentions could have been missed. A deadline date counts as an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to keep in the team channel.
